exposure: time after birth (1 minute and 5 minutes)
cohort: 114 infants with delayed cord clamping and 407 infants with early cord clamping
finding: Infants selected for delayed cord clamping had significantly higher Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes and higher umbilical artery pO2 compared to infants with early cord clamping.
mod_finding: This study compared blood gas parameters in infants delivered with delayed cord clamping versus early cord clamping.
